response.sql: WITH cw AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avgw FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avgw) AS o FROM cw), above AS (SELECT cw.country, cw.avgw FROM cw, overall WHERE cw.avgw > overall.o), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avgw) AS b FROM above), final AS (SELECT a.country, a.avgw FROM above a, grp WHERE a.avgw > grp.b) SELECT AVG(f.avgw) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(f.avgw - overall.o) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(f.avgw - grp.b) AS mean_excess_over_above_group FROM final f, overall, grp;
